d: По итогам выборов в Госдуму «Единая Россия» получает 349 депутатских мандатов. Об этом сообщила глава Центризбиркома РФ Элла Памфилова 25 сентября на заседании комиссии по утверждению итогов выборов в Госдуму девятого созыва.
te: “United Russia” on the results of the elections receives 349 mandates in the state Duma
de: According to the results of the elections to the state Duma, United Russia receives 349 deputy mandates. This was reported by the head of the Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation Ella Pamfilova on September 25 at a meeting of the Commission on approval of the results of elections to the state Duma of the ninth convocation.

te: Pamfilova: the action with the spoiling of ballots in the elections to the state Duma failed
de: Calls to spoil the ballots in the elections to the state Duma, which were published in social networks abroad, did not have the desired effect of their distributors. This was stated by the Chairman of the CEC of Russia Ella Pamfilova, summing up the preliminary results.

t: В ЦИК поступило свыше шести тысяч обращений за время выборов

te: The CEC received more than six thousand appeals during the elections
de: During the elections of 2026, the CEC received more than 6.5 thousand appeals, 88% of them did not contain information about possible violations. This was reported by the Chairman of the CEC of the Russian Federation Ella Pamfilova.

t: Памфилова: Использование дронов на выборах позволило сэкономить средства
d: Использование беспилотников для организации голосования на труднодоступных и удаленных территориях позволило сэкономить как финансовые, так и человеческие ресурсы. Об этом заявила председатель Центризбиркома РФ Элла Памфилова.
te: Pamfilova: The use of drones in the elections allowed to save money
de: The use of drones to organize voting in hard-to-reach and remote areas has saved both financial and human resources. This was stated by the Chairman of the Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation Ella Pamfilova.

t: Депутат Колесник: На краснолиманском направлении в ДНР идет борьба воль

te: Deputy Kolesnik: On the Krasnolimansk direction in the DPR is a struggle of will

te: Golikova: “Pushkin card” is used by 90% of Russian youth
de: The Pushkin card is used by about 90 percent of young people aged 14 to 23 years. Nearly 13,000 cultural institutions offer 70,000 events as part of the programme. This was reported by Deputy Prime Minister Tatyana Golikova.

te: Colombia breaks diplomatic relations with Iran

te: Museums in 2025 visited more than a third of the inhabitants of Russia
de: More than a third of Russians visited museums in 2025. This was said by Deputy Prime Minister Tatyana Golikova.

de: The interference of external forces in the internal affairs of Iran, which are the responsibility of the Iranian people, is unacceptable. This was stated by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan in an interview with Newsweek magazine.
